claim: In 1890 James Naismith left Canada for a position as a physical education teacher at the YMCA training school in Springfield, Massachusetts.

evidence.quote: James A. Naismith, a native of Ontario, left Canada in 1890 for a position as a physical education teacher at the YMCA training school in Springfield, Massachusetts.

notes: Round 9 (globe-to-map, 2026-10-29): atomic restatement of NAI-F-0006 (adversary 'unclear': it joined 'a native of Ontario' to the move) without the birthplace attribute, so the Canada to Springfield direction can be judged on its own. One holder (Smithsonian National Postal Museum); no second registered holder states the departure from Canada (KU finding aid NAI-S-0017 says he 'moved to attend Springfield College in Massachusetts' that year, Springfield College NAI-S-0004 that he 'headed to Springfield' after Presbyterian College in Montreal; neither shares the wording). Expected single-source.
